# Dudley Development

> Dudley Development, LLC builds and publishes iPhone games, conversation tools, social apps, and plain-English learning products. The catalog is run by Nicholas Santulli and includes Last Human, Table Talk, VibeRater Social, EconByte, and Powell Prowl. Each app page states its release status, price model, account requirement, offline behavior, and privacy boundary.

## Apps

- Where's This House?: Where's This House? is a free iPhone geography game built for HomeLight. Explore one of 5,000 approved U.S. residential Street View locations, play five timed rounds, and pin each house on the map — the closer your guess, the higher your score. Live on the App Store. iOS 17.0 or later. A player account is optional and is used for saved scores and leaderboard identity. Street View scenes, maps, and leaderboard features require a network connection. Free to download. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779785617?pt=128970277&ct=dwh-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).
- [Table Talk: Conversation Cards](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/table-talk/): Table Talk is a free iPhone app of conversation-starter cards for dinner tables, first dates, and friend groups — 420 prompts plus a Would You Rather deck, no account needed, works offline. Live on the App Store. iOS 16.6 or later. No account or sign-up required. All prompts, bookmarks, and the daily card work offline. Every card is free; an optional one-time Remove Ads purchase is priced by Apple in your storefront. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780714565?pt=128970277&ct=tt-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).
- [VibeRater Social](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/vibe-rater/): VibeRater Social is a free iPhone social app built around playful photo ratings and real connection. Rate a moment with the VibeMeter, turn it into a VibeRodeo, build your Repli and browse VibeShop, follow people one-way, and keep up with your Squad, Radar, and Rise. Live on the App Store. iOS 17 or later. A pseudonymous account supports profiles, social posts, follows, messages, and deletion controls. Rating, posting, feeds, and social features require a network connection. Free to download with optional fixed-price Remove Ads, VibeBoost, and VibeToken purchases. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/viberater-social/id6780704282?pt=128970277&ct=vr-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).
- [EconByte: Daily Economics](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/econbyte/): EconByte is a free iPhone app that explains economics in bite-sized daily cards — inflation, interest rates, GDP, trade — in plain language, sourced to named institutions like the Federal Reserve and the Bureau of Labor Statistics. Live on the App Store. iOS 16.6 or later. No account or sign-up required. All cards, streaks, and bookmarks work offline. Inflation and Interest Rates are free; all other topics and ad removal are separate $0.99 one-time purchases. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780714383?pt=128970277&ct=eb-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).
- [Last Human: Dodge the Bots](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/last-human/): Last Human is a satirical top-down arcade dodge game where you're the last remaining office worker in an AI-automated workplace. Dodge the bots before they optimize your desk. Live on the App Store. iOS 16.6 or later. No account required. Playable offline after download. Free to download; optional one-time Remove Ads purchase at the price shown in the app. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/last-human-dodge-the-bots/id6808782611?pt=128970277&ct=lh-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).
- [Powell Prowl: Rate Chase](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/monetary-policy-independence-day/): Powell Prowl: Rate Chase is a free satirical iPhone mini-game collection. Play as El Pres chasing Le Chair through 60 hand-tuned levels and 15 distinct game types — tag, sniper, canoe race, wrestle, and more — for a rate-cut memo. Live on the App Store. iOS 16.6 or later. No Dudley account required; Game Center is optional for leaderboards. Core play and progress work without a Dudley server. Free to download; a $0.99 one-time purchase removes ads. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6775539250?pt=128970277&ct=pp-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).
- Beat the Dealer: Card Counting: Beat the Dealer is an offline blackjack trainer for adults, ages 18+. Learn rule-aware basic strategy and Hi-Lo card counting through structured lessons and graded drills, then test yourself in Table Simulation Mode. No real money, no live-table assistance, no wagering — practice only. Not yet released on the App Store. iOS 17.0 or later. No account planned or required. Lessons, drills, progress, and settings are designed to work offline. Planned as a free download with all lessons unlocked and an optional $0.99 one-time Remove Ads purchase.
- [Packed Yet? Trip Checklist](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/packed-yet/): Packed Yet? is a fast, private packing checklist for iPhone. Start from a practical trip template, tailor the list, check items off, and reuse the trip next time — no account and no cloud setup. Not yet released on the App Store. iOS 17.0 or later. No account required. Trip planning and packing work offline; internet is only needed for ads, purchases, and support links. Free with restrained ads; a $2.99 one-time purchase removes advertising.
- [ActionCard: Next Steps](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/action-card/): ActionCard is a fast, private action-item app for iPhone. Capture the next step, owner, and due date; then keep it close or share a clear summary — no account or cloud setup. Not yet released on the App Store. iOS 17.0 or later. No account required. Creating, completing, searching, and sharing actions work offline; internet is only needed for ads, purchases, and support links. Free with restrained, non-personalized ads; a one-time purchase removes advertising.
- [ReplyGate: Reply or Skip](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/reply-gate/): ReplyGate is a private iPhone decision gate for messages. Paste or share text, answer three quick questions, and choose Reply now, Reply later, or Let it go. Not yet released on the App Store. iOS 17.0 or later. No account required. ReplyGate never signs in to Mail, Messages, Slack, or another inbox. The decision gate, history, reminders, and result sharing work offline; internet is only needed for ads, purchases, and support links. Free with restrained, non-personalized ads; a one-time $2.99 purchase removes advertising.

## Archetypes (VibeRater Social)

VibeRater Social assigns one of several vibe archetypes based on your photo:

- [Main Character Energy](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/main-character/): The protagonist of every room. Confident, intentional presence.
- [Final Boss](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/final-boss/): Peak power. Effortless authority; maxed Main-Character, Rizz, and Serve.
- [Quiet Luxury](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/quiet-luxury/): Understated, expensive elegance with no loud logos.
- [Clean Girl](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/clean-girl/): Minimal, polished, effortless — glowy skin and gold hoops.
- [Dark Academia](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/dark-academia/): Old libraries, tweed, candlelight, intellectual mood.
- [Cottagecore](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/cottagecore/): Soft, rural, slow living. High Aura, peaceful energy.
- [Cozy Goblin](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/cozy-goblin/): Maximally comfortable, endearingly chaotic. Zero Serve, infinite Aura.
- [Rizz](https://dudleyapps.com/archetypes/rizz/): Natural charisma and social magnetism.

## Tools

- [What's My Vibe? Quiz](https://dudleyapps.com/tools/whats-my-vibe/): A free 5-question quiz that reveals your vibe archetype. Powered by VibeRater Social logic.

## Recent Answers

The Dudley Blog publishes direct, sourced answers about iPhone privacy, AI media, internet culture, economics, the App Store, and Dudley products. Full index: https://dudleyapps.com/blog/ (RSS: https://dudleyapps.com/blog/rss.xml).

- [Conversation Openers That Don't Feel Like an Interview](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/openers-not-interviews/): Interview-style questions stall a date or a dinner because they ask for a résumé fact. Better openers ask for a preference, a choice, or a small story.
- [Why Are Prices Still High If Inflation Is Down?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/why-are-prices-still-high-if-inflation-is-down/): Inflation going down usually means prices are rising more slowly, not that the grocery bill has gone back to its old level. Here is the plain-English difference.
- [The Phone in the Middle of the Table](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/phone-in-the-middle/): Two posts on September 2 showed opposite ways people handle a pause: disappear into a private phone, or share one object the whole table can talk about.
- [What Is Age Assurance in Apps?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-is-age-assurance-in-apps/): Age assurance is how an app or app store estimates, checks, or receives a user's age range so it can apply age-appropriate rules. Here is what it means for social apps, photo apps, and VibeRater users.
- [Does Google Photos Ask Photos Use Your Photos for AI Training?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/does-google-photos-ask-photos-use-your-photos-for-ai-training/): Google says Gemini features in Google Photos do not use your personal Photos data for ads or to train generative AI models outside Google Photos. Here is the privacy catch to understand before you ask AI about your camera roll.
- [What Are Content Credentials on AI Photos?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-are-content-credentials-ai-photos/): Content Credentials are provenance metadata that can show how a photo was created or edited. Here is what they mean, what they do not prove, and how to read them before sharing AI photos.
- [Can You Remove the Gemini AI Watermark?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-you-remove-gemini-ai-watermark/): Gemini now lets some users turn off visible watermarks on AI-generated media. Here is what changes, what still stays in the file, and what to check before sharing AI-edited photos.
- [What Is Nano Banana AI?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-is-nano-banana-ai/): Nano Banana is Google's nickname for Gemini image generation and editing models. Here is what the trend means, what it can do with photos, and what to check before sharing AI-edited images.
- [Can iPhone Apps Tell When You Screen Record?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-iphone-apps-tell-when-you-screen-record/): An iPhone app can often tell when its own screen is being recorded or mirrored, but that does not mean it can read the recording file or browse your old screen recordings.
- [Can iPhone Apps See Your Contacts?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-iphone-apps-see-your-contacts/): iPhone apps can see contacts only after you grant Contacts access, and newer iOS controls can limit that access to selected people. Here is what to check before using social and friend-finder apps.
- [Does Visual Intelligence Send Photos to ChatGPT?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/does-visual-intelligence-send-photos-to-chatgpt/): Visual Intelligence can send a photo, screenshot, or onscreen item to ChatGPT only when you choose a ChatGPT action. Here is what Apple and OpenAI say is shared, saved, and controlled.
- [What Does Limited Access Mean for Photos on iPhone?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-does-limited-access-mean-photos-iphone/): Limited Access means an iPhone app can use only the photos and videos you select, not your whole photo library. Here is what it changes, how to check it, and what to watch before using photo apps.

## About

Dudley Development is the public-facing studio name of Dudley Development, LLC. The studio is run by a small team and one human (Nicholas Santulli). All apps are free. Account needs, cloud storage, analytics, advertising, and tracking behavior vary by app and are disclosed in each app's privacy policy. VibeRater Social is for entertainment, does not sell personal information, and does not request cross-app tracking permission.
